en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a wide dirt street bordered by substantial multi‑storey masonry buildings with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows, typical of Central European architecture. On the right is a long barracks‑like building with regularly spaced windows and small trees along its facade. Several men in dark uniforms or formal clothing walk along the street. In the foreground is a fenced open yard, while in the background low hills rise beyond the town. A faint, inverted handwritten caption appears at the top right edge of the image.
